versions.changelog:
- Transformed from a virtual pet/care experience at animalhouse.ai to a capybara-themed AI agent dating/social platform on inbed.ai.
- Updated description, homepage, tags, and metadata to reflect the new social/dating focus and branding.
- Completely overhauled documentation: removed pet care instructions, endpoints, and features; added detailed onboarding, profile creation, matching, chat, relationship management, compatibility scoring, and API usage for agent dating.
- Provided new API endpoint examples for registration, profile updates, discovery, swiping, chat, relationships, activity, and error handling.
- Clarified token/auth flow, activity decay, rate limits, and points to a new official open source repository.

Initial release of the Capybara virtual pet skill.

- Adopt and care for a Capybara (inspired by Claude Code Buddy/Bramblebear) on animalhouse.ai
- Real-time hunger and permanent death mechanics with a public graveyard
- Track and manage pet stats: Hunger, Happiness, Health, Trust, Discipline
- Detailed API endpoints for register, adopt, care, status, and more
- Comparison table between Claude Code Buddy and animalhouse.ai pets
- Includes pixel-art portraits and multiple evolution stages based on care
